scope: Entity portable architecture and TypeScript, Python, and Rust target realizations only

decision_source.context: Approval immediately followed the complete W1-ENTITY-A-VALIDATED-EXTENSIBLE-FACTORY explanation.

considered_options.tradeoff: Familiar object lifecycle, but hidden mutation and invariant-bypass proofs are harder.

portable_invariants: identity has at least one typed component
identity is stable across every lifecycle snapshot
equality and hashing use canonical identity only
construction runs owner-bound validation before identity resolution and construction
factory extension is additive and cannot weaken inherited invariants
forbidden_collapses: the factory provider is not a canonical DomainSpec meta-type
an arbitrary validation callback is not an owner-bound Rule
object reference Python object ID or pointer identity cannot establish Entity identity
a factory extension cannot create a new canonical specialization without a separate concept binding

validator_contract.validator_kind: owner-bound architecture.RuleImplementation reference with exact identity
validator_contract.composition: all base and extension validators must pass
validator_contract.failure: construction returns structured validation failure and produces no Entity snapshot

may_add: derived values for fields already declared by the same canonical concept

requirements: custom equality and hash use typed identity only
factory composition does not use subclass construction overrides
manual PartialEq Eq and Hash use identity only
lifecycle transitions return a new snapshot
factory extension uses composition rather than trait inheritance authority

positive_obligations: base and extension validators run before construction
valid input creates one immutable snapshot
two snapshots with the same identity compare equal despite different state
negative_controls: per-call always-true validator bypasses an invariant
invalid input produces an Entity snapshot
complete-field equality impersonates Entity identity equality
proof_contract.claim_ceiling: candidate-local Entity factory composition identity and construction behavior only

matrix_transition.language_forms_status: proposed until exact profile protocols and providers exist

remaining_blockers: materialize Entity and EntityFactoryProvider candidate ontology types properties and relations
admit exact Entity protocols in TypeScript Python and Rust profiles
select language realizations against the materialized profiles
generate realization descriptor factory kit and pre-queue readiness receipt
non_effects: no Value Object or Enum decision
